plan: Drive: from Germansen Landing, about 96 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.42976, -124.98206, pull off on Finlay FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 6.3 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 144 m, about 141 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 270 m NW of the spot at 859 m (56.38716, -125.04839). Water: unnamed lake 130 m S (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-38, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2024-07-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AH-duck-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-38: about 1,923 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.15 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
